title: Fix Erlang semantic relation correctness for server_flexible
description:
## Summary
Correct native Erlang extraction/resolution defects found by deep review: record field/update references, context-free MFA tuple false positives, tuple no_auto_import, remote atom whitespace, rpc:multicall overloads, and unreachable include fallback. The goal is precise review context for server_flexible, not broader grammar coverage.

## Steps to Reproduce
Run the focused minimal parser/resolver cases documented by the deep review against b768371.
acceptance_criteria: Regression tests demonstrate red on b768371 and green after the fix; record access/update relations are emitted; ordinary data triples do not become MFA references; supported static MFA contexts remain; BIF/remote/rpc/include cases resolve conservatively; focused Erlang tests pass.
close_reason: Semantic extraction/resolution hard stops fixed and independently rechecked; full Python 3.13 suite passed.

title: Make Erlang graph lifecycle deterministic and atomic
description:
## Summary
Fix upgrade migration, repository-root ownership, atomic relation reconciliation, fatal propagation, exactly-once execution, layout-only updates, and identity metadata behavior so every build/update/watch/forget/postprocess path converges.

## Steps to Reproduce
Use old/mixed graph fixtures, injected TESTED_BY failure, nested OTP layout postprocess, duplicate reconciliation call counting, and rebar.config-only incremental updates against b768371.
acceptance_criteria: Old graphs with repository Erlang sources force one full rebuild; explicit or stored canonical repo root is used safely; resolver and TESTED_BY roll back together; fatal reaches user/watch boundaries; each entry point reconciles exactly once; layout-only updates refresh derived state; unrelated parse errors do not cause permanent Erlang rebuild loops.
notes: Final ship-gate regressions reopened this lifecycle issue: standalone postprocess must enforce identity migration, automatic update must see untracked Erlang layout config, forget must exclude erlang_ls.config and reject mismatched shared-database ownership, and watch must retry derived postprocessing after failure.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Exercise real incremental update in disposable server mirror
description: The adoption lifecycle currently passes a changed Erlang path without changing bytes, so incremental_update reports files_updated=0 and the parity gate stays false. Add an isolated, read-only-safe smoke path that mutates/restores only a disposable server_flexible mirror, records update evidence, and preserves target checkout contents and required semantic policy.
close_reason: Incremental smoke now runs in an evaluator-owned Git-capable disposable mirror, restores its temporary source mutation, records positive update evidence, and verifies the external target remains unchanged.

title: Normalize semantic evidence IDs in forget parity fingerprints
description: The strict server_flexible forget lifecycle compares a graph after forget with a fresh mirror. Semantic projection evidence IDs include absolute checkout paths, so equivalent graphs from different temporary mirrors produce different portable fingerprints. Define parity fingerprint normalization for checkout-scoped semantic evidence metadata and add regression coverage without weakening relation/provenance validation.
close_reason: Portable parity now canonicalizes checkout-scoped semantic IDs and repository identity; regression coverage passes.

title: Raise Erlang project command timeout for server_flexible
description: The strict Erlang profile caps semantic/project command timeout at 300 seconds, while the authoritative server_flexible compile has measured around 441 seconds on the current baseline. Raise the bounded timeout ceiling and manifest value so required preparation is not falsely classified as timeout.
close_reason: Raised strict adapter validator and ELP/xref/Dialyzer manifests to 900 seconds; focused adapter/adoption tests pass.

title: Fix isolated forget parity checkout preparation
description: The Erlang adoption evaluator builds a temporary mirror for forget parity, but excluding .git prevents server_flexible authoritative ./xserver.sh compile from validating project state. Create an isolated Git-capable mirror without mutating the external target, and add regression coverage.
close_reason: Implemented isolated Git-capable forget mirror and regression coverage; verified project preparation on a real server_flexible mirror.

title: Align Erlang adapters with server_flexible project entrypoints
description: Update the Erlang evaluation manifest and semantic adapters to honor server_flexible's authoritative ./xserver.sh compile and ./xserver.sh dialyzer workflow. Distinguish xref diagnostic warnings from tool execution failure while keeping required-tool fail-closed semantics; add focused regression tests and rerun validation.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest pins origin/develop revision and generated data with authoritative commands; xref warnings preserve module evidence and are not confused with execution failure; Dialyzer uses project entrypoint and matching PLT; focused tests pass.
close_reason: Aligned server_flexible authoritative xserver entrypoints, preserved xref warning diagnostics, updated OTP 27.3.4.16/develop manifest, and verified 3239 hermetic tests plus focused adapter/integration coverage. Real adoption remains blocked by unavailable P4 service.

title: Validate latest develop with authoritative xserver compile
description: Re-evaluate Erlang adoption against server_flexible origin/develop using the repository-required ./xserver.sh compile and ./xserver.sh dialyzer entrypoints before interpreting xref or generated-data failures.
acceptance_criteria: Latest origin/develop revision is recorded; authoritative compile generation path is attempted in a disposable worktree; first failure and generated-data/toolchain evidence are recorded without modifying the consumer repository.
close_reason: Pinned origin/develop db6f93e95b432efcd1e337159fc3e4a235084476 and generated-data 57057 in a disposable worktree; authoritative ./xserver.sh compile was attempted and blocked at P4 login because 192.168.110.82:1667 was unreachable. Consumer checkout remained read-only.

title: Refresh server_flexible adoption report
description: Replace stale historical adoption markdown with the latest strict-policy evaluation for revision fd65517 and generated-data revision 53569, including the xref blocking result.
acceptance_criteria: Tracked report names current revision/toolchain, generated data, strict blocked verdict, and actual lifecycle diagnostics without claiming unrun gates passed.
close_reason: Report now records current fd65517/53569 strict blocked evaluation and no stale metrics

title: Read server_flexible generated data revision marker
description: Teach compute_generated_data_revision to read server_flexible tools/gen_data/data_rev_info DATA_REV marker and cover it with regression tests.
acceptance_criteria: The server_flexible data_rev_info marker yields its DATA_REV value and existing content-digest behavior remains unchanged.
close_reason: compute_generated_data_revision now reads tools/gen_data/data_rev_info DATA_REV with regression coverage

title: Use real ELP server protocol for targeted semantic queries
description: Replace the fictional elp query CLI invocation with the ELP 1.1 server JSON-RPC protocol. Keep ELP CLI as the required dependency, map targeted callers/impact/references queries to call hierarchy and references responses, preserve provenance and strict failures, and add protocol-focused tests.
close_reason: Implemented ELP 1.1 server JSON-RPC adapter, strict manifest invocation, validator support, tests, and documentation alignment in d5138f8 and 27573bd

title: Reduce Erlang full and no-op lifecycle cost
description: Use the new stage timings to reduce repository-wide work in server_flexible full, incremental, no-op, and standalone postprocess paths. Preserve graph/evidence parity and fail-closed semantics; do not relax adoption gates.
design: Keep Generic and Hybrid relation contracts unchanged. Prefer revision/hash/layout keyed skips and bulk SQLite operations over removing required evidence. Add regression coverage for changed and unchanged lifecycle paths.
acceptance_criteria: Real pinned server_flexible probes show stage timings for full/incremental/no-op/postprocess; no-op and one-file incremental avoid unnecessary repository-wide Erlang/header/signature/call reconciliation; focused parity tests pass; performance report is updated only with measured results.
close_reason: Measured pinned server_flexible stages after optimization: full build + full postprocess 26.949-28.169s (p95 27.4478s), one-file incremental 5.09-5.42s, no-op 0.233-0.237s; focused parity/lifecycle tests pass.

title: Profile Erlang lifecycle stages and fix closed-database failure
description: Add bounded phase-level observability to the Erlang adoption evaluator, reproduce the real server_flexible lifecycle timeout/closed-database warning, and fix the database lifetime defect without changing the auxiliary adoption boundary.
design: Keep Generic and Hybrid semantics unchanged. Instrument lifecycle boundaries with monotonic timings and diagnostics. Preserve fail-closed behavior and do not claim adoption promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluator records partial phase timings on failure or timeout; closed-database warning is either fixed or reduced to a precise regression; focused evaluator/lifecycle tests pass; changes are committed separately from any follow-up performance optimization.
close_reason: Added stage-level timings for full/incremental/postprocess, reproduced the fixed server_flexible bottleneck (Erlang header resolver), reduced repeated path-scope overhead, and prevented watch timeout teardown from closing a live worker store. Focused tests and real pinned full-build probe pass; adoption remains auxiliary.

title: Add isolated lifecycle runner for Erlang adoption watch smoke
description: Implement a bounded evaluator-owned lifecycle runner that mirrors the pinned target checkout into a temporary directory, keeps target files read-only, and can execute watch smoke plus explicitly configured adapter evidence without ambient configuration leakage. Preserve fail-closed status on timeout, malformed envelopes, target writes, or unavailable tools; add focused tests for default watch execution and cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Default evaluator watch smoke uses an isolated mirror when requested; external target remains unchanged; adapter execution is explicit and policy-bounded; timeout/failure paths are reported and cannot satisfy adoption gates; focused tests cover success and failure.
notes: Audit 2026-08-30: no safe in-scope implementation yet. A default watch runner needs a temporary checkout mirror, bounded trigger/stop coordination, and execution-root remapping. External adapter execution remains blocked because checked-in ELP/xref/Dialyzer manifests set enforcement.runtime_policy_enforced=false and rebar3 tasks may write build/cache or execute project hooks. Existing default watch_smoke=False/not_run contract is covered by tests/test_erlang_adoption.py::test_clean_fixture_executes_graph_lifecycle_and_scores_query. Keep this issue open for a dedicated sandbox/policy phase.
close_reason: Implemented disposable mirror watch smoke with bounded readiness/teardown, target snapshot checks, and focused success/timeout tests.

title: Reject generic-only semantic execution as adoption success
description: The adoption evaluator must not treat the always-on Generic adapter as proof that semantic adapters executed. Restrict semantic execution success to declared non-generic adapters and add a regression test for a generic-only envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Generic-only lifecycle envelopes remain invalid for semantic execution; a declared external adapter with explicit success can satisfy the execution check; focused evaluator tests pass.
close_reason: Restricted semantic execution evidence to declared non-generic adapters and added generic-only regression coverage.

title: Implement executable server_flexible Erlang adoption evaluation
description: Replace evaluator scaffold with repeatable graph/lifecycle runner, score corpus precision/recall/impact/latency, and check in adoption report only from a clean pinned target baseline.
notes: Implemented in dfa0406. The evaluator is executable, read-only, fail-closed, validates result integrity, and emits JSON/Markdown reports. Focused evaluator tests pass; the default server_flexible run remains blocked by target revision/dirty/submodule/toolchain drift, so adoption is not claimed.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Add execution manifests and hermetic boundaries for Erlang adapters
description: Define and enforce reviewable manifests for ELP, rebar3 xref, and Dialyzer. Validate command allowlists, cwd/filesystem/network policy, and return observable unavailable/degraded status when no valid policy exists.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Reject foreign checkout paths at lifecycle input boundaries
description: Prevent forget_files and incremental/watch updates from mutating files outside the requested repository when a shared GraphStore contains mixed roots. Add mixed-root regression coverage and make legacy Erlang projection cleanup fail closed.
close_reason: Implemented per-target repository ownership checks, fail-closed legacy projection cleanup, scoped integration metadata, and regression tests.

title: Integrate Erlang semantic evidence across graph lifecycle
description: Persist revision-keyed Erlang adapter evidence and expose it through build, incremental update, watch, forget, standalone postprocess, and normal query/review responses without weakening Generic fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Generic indexing remains usable when tools are unavailable; enabled adapter evidence and diagnostics are persisted, stale evidence is removed, lifecycle paths converge, and query/review responses expose provenance.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Integrate server_flexible manifest and Erlang evaluation corpus
description: Freeze the target repository/toolchain/generated-data manifest and add repeatable golden cases and performance/adoption measurements.
acceptance_criteria: Corpus cases and manifest are reproducible and report precision, recall, impact, latency, and fallback outcomes.
notes: Manifest/corpus integration is implemented and consumed by the evaluator in dfa0406. The checked-in artifact is intentionally a scaffold with metrics not_run; real clean-baseline adoption measurement remains tracked separately by crg-69r and its dependencies.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

title: Add Erlang hybrid evidence adapter boundary
description: Add optional ELP, rebar3 xref, and Dialyzer adapter contracts with provenance, diagnostics, fallback, and revision-aware evidence integration.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter failures preserve Generic indexing; valid evidence is observable and provenance-aware; focused adapter tests pass.
close_reason: Adapter contracts, bounded failure handling, provenance, cache, and focused tests implemented in bdba741.

title: Implement Generic Erlang baseline from current main
description: Add Erlang file detection, Tree-sitter baseline nodes, stable identities, syntax evidence, and Generic-only integration for server_flexible.
acceptance_criteria: Erlang .erl/.hrl/.app.src files index through the normal build/update/watch/forget paths without optional semantic tools; focused regression tests pass.
close_reason: Generic Erlang baseline implemented and verified in 29e22cf

title: Verify dirty-file update and restore-to-HEAD consistency
description: Exercise incremental update with an unstaged Erlang edit followed by restoring the file to HEAD, ensuring graph state and identity metadata converge to repository contents.
acceptance_criteria: A production-path regression test proves dirty update, restore, and no-op reconciliation produce the same graph relations and current identity marker as a clean rebuild.
notes: No external dirty-file/restore gate is claimed; the evaluator refuses the current dirty target and records the blocked state.
close_reason: Added automatic Erlang hash reconciliation for working-tree restore cases; production-path test verifies dirty update, restore parity, no-op stability, identity marker, and clean rebuild equivalence.

title: Curate server_flexible Erlang review golden cases
description: Build a fixed-revision corpus from real reviews, incidents, and change questions so Erlang review-context quality is measured against human-confirmed answers rather than smoke queries.
acceptance_criteria: Golden cases record expected callers, dependencies, tests, and impact answers; report resolved-edge precision, Recall@10, impact quality, and an auxiliary-versus-primary adoption verdict.
notes: No golden-case gate is claimed. The checked-in corpus is a scaffold with manual anchors; execute and manually verify cases on a clean pinned target before closing.
close_reason: Checked in manually reviewed server_flexible corpus with complete source/target relation expectations, unresolved and fallback cases, and impact ground truth; local graph scoring reports precision/recall/impact 1.0.

title: Establish Erlang performance gates on server_flexible
description: Measure repeatable full-build, one-file incremental, layout-only, and no-op performance on a fixed server_flexible revision. The current 178.70 second full build is smoke evidence, not an adoption pass.
acceptance_criteria: Record the repository revision, machine/profile, warmup policy, repeated timings, thresholds, and pass/fail verdict for full and incremental paths.
notes: Checked in repeatable server_flexible performance report for bc8a4424 with serial parsing policy, 3 full-build samples (51.589/52.667/54.572s; p95 54381.173ms), 3 incremental samples (47.724/47.873/47.912s), 3 no-op samples (23.929/23.931/23.961s), one restore sample, thresholds, and explicit fail verdict: full-build p95 exceeds 30000ms; targeted query p95 passes; layout-only remains not_run.
close_reason: Checked in repeatable server_flexible performance report for bc8a4424 with serial parsing policy, samples, budgets, and explicit fail verdict: full-build p95 55398.869ms exceeds 30000ms; targeted query p95 passes; layout-only and full lifecycle repeatability remain not green.

title: Validate Erlang review context on server_flexible
description:
## Summary
Evaluate the corrected implementation on a fixed server_flexible revision using real code questions and stage timings. This determines auxiliary versus primary review-context adoption; it is not an upstream merge task.

## Steps to Reproduce
Build server_flexible at a recorded revision, run curated callers/include/record/callback/tests-for/impact questions, and time full, one-file incremental, layout-only, and no-op paths.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluation records repository revision, profile, real questions with expected answers, precision/recall/impact observations, full and incremental timings, and a defensible adoption verdict. No upstream PR is created.
notes: Current baseline is origin/develop db6f93e95b432efcd1e337159fc3e4a235084476 with generated data 57057, OTP 27.3.4.16, ERTS 15.2.7.12, rebar3 3.27.0, Dialyzer 5.3.1.1, ELP 1.1.0+build-2026-01-15, and _build/dialyzer/.dialyzer.plt SHA256 1730142f65c9296c34079f4242c7d7f08f1740fe6d619cf976f4b3abc4240a01. Required project workflow is ./xserver.sh compile, ./xserver.sh dialyzer, then rebar3 xref. The disposable-worktree adoption rerun is blocked at ./xserver.sh compile: P4 session/server 192.168.110.82:1667 is unreachable (p4 login -s: No route to host). Semantic, lifecycle, precision/recall/impact, and latency gates remain unmeasured; adoption remains auxiliary_review_context_only until P4 is available.

title: Align server_flexible performance provenance
description: Update the checked-in performance report provenance to the current fd65517/53569 baseline while retaining older timing samples as explicitly historical data.
acceptance_criteria: Performance JSON no longer declares bc8a442/35021 as the current target; historical samples remain traceable and current adoption status is blocked/unmeasured.
close_reason: Performance report now distinguishes current fd65517/53569 blocked evaluation from historical bc8a442/35021 timings

title: Keep Erlang Clause nodes out of callable adoption anchors
description: The Generic parser now exposes Clause children, but the adoption evaluator's file-qualified symbol resolver counts Function and Clause nodes together and returns no anchor. Exclude Clause from callable endpoint resolution while preserving explicit Function/Test queries and add a regression test.
acceptance_criteria: A file-qualified Erlang function anchor resolves uniquely despite Clause children; adoption fixture scoring remains 1.0 precision/recall; Clause nodes are not returned as callable semantic endpoints.
close_reason: Excluded Clause navigation children from adoption callable symbol matching and restored fixture scoring; adoption suite passes.

title: Add stable Erlang clause nodes to Generic baseline
description: The Erlang support plan requires stable syntax-backed clause nodes, including multi-clause functions. Current Generic parsing only merges clauses into Function metadata. Add bounded Clause nodes with deterministic identities and containment while preserving existing function-level queries and lifecycle behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Multi-clause and single-clause Erlang functions expose deterministic Clause nodes with source spans, parent/function identity, and CONTAINS edges; existing Function identities, calls, tests, and lifecycle fingerprints remain compatible; focused parser/lifecycle tests pass.
close_reason: Added deterministic Erlang Clause nodes and Function-to-Clause containment while preserving callable Function identities; focused parser/lifecycle suites pass.

title: Report bounded Erlang AST walk truncation
description: The Generic Erlang walker caps named descendants at 100000 but currently truncates silently. Preserve the bounded behavior while attaching an observable file diagnostic whenever the cap is reached, with regression coverage.
acceptance_criteria: A legal Erlang AST exceeding the walk budget remains bounded and emits a deterministic erlang diagnostic; normal files remain unchanged; focused parser/lifecycle tests pass.
close_reason: Bounded Erlang traversal now raises a deterministic parse error; full-build regression confirms no partial file graph and leaves identity pending.

title: Expose Erlang integration diagnostics from forget CLI
description: The public forget command calls forget_files, which returns an erlang_integration status and diagnostics, but cli.py currently prints only file counts and reparsed files. Surface the integration status and bounded diagnostics consistently with build, update, and postprocess so optional adapter failures are observable.
acceptance_criteria: The public forget command with a degraded Erlang lifecycle prints the integration status and diagnostic code; ordinary forget output remains unchanged; add a focused CLI regression test.
close_reason: Forget CLI now prints Erlang integration status and diagnostics; focused CLI tests pass.

title: Stabilize watch reconciliation tests under full-suite execution
description: Hermetic full-suite runs on main intermittently fail existing watch reconciliation tests even when tests/test_erlang_adoption.py is excluded. Observed failures include startup stale-file callback/postprocess warning, Python import re-resolution after deletion, and repair re-read after watcher outage; isolated reruns are inconsistent. Determine whether this is a runtime race or test isolation leak and make the watch contract deterministic.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated hermetic full-suite runs do not intermittently fail the affected watch reconciliation cases, and targeted tests use deterministic coordination rather than timing assumptions.
close_reason: Repeated startup, callback serialization, and repair reconciliation tests passed in three consecutive runs.

title: Fail closed on Erlang analyzer recursion errors
description: A legal deeply nested Erlang AST can exceed Python recursion depth. The parser records an error, but the public build wrapper still reports status=ok with zero semantic content, allowing incomplete graphs to feed review queries.
acceptance_criteria: Use bounded/iterative traversal or a safe equivalent, and ensure public build/eval paths surface parse errors as non-success. Cover legal nested Erlang input without weakening ordinary parse-error reporting.
close_reason: Iterative Erlang traversal and degraded build status are now enforced at parser, build, and public CLI/evaluator boundaries; focused regressions pass.

title: Normalize escapes in quoted Erlang atoms
description: Normalize escaped characters in quoted Erlang module and function atoms so equivalent source spellings resolve to canonical static MFA identities.
acceptance_criteria: Parser and resolver tests cover escaped quoted atoms, preserve conservative dynamic-call handling, and resolve only semantically equivalent canonical identities.
notes: Also cover legal quoted module/function atoms containing MFA identity delimiters; current colon/slash serialization is ambiguous in addition to escape normalization.
close_reason: Shared quoted-atom normalization and MFA parser now cover escaped delimiters, conservative validation, resolver and public query paths; focused tests pass.

title: Improve Erlang record and header review-context recall
description: Evaluate review queries that depend on record fields and included headers, then close verified recall gaps needed by server_flexible reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed-revision cases include expected header importers and record consumers, with measured recall and no cross-application include regressions.
close_reason: Scoped header/record closure and review-context recall are implemented with focused regression coverage.

title: Improve Erlang tests_for recall across helper chains
description: Evaluate and improve tests_for results where Erlang tests reach production functions through helper modules or setup chains, without lowering precision through speculative edges.
acceptance_criteria: Production-derived cases demonstrate the current miss, the corrected graph returns the expected tests within the agreed rank, and false-positive behavior remains bounded.
close_reason: Helper-chain tests_for traversal and rank/precision regressions are implemented and focused suites pass.

title: Harden Erlang query aliases and adoption documentation
description:
## Summary
Bound public Erlang MFA alias parsing so malformed arities cannot crash MCP/CLI queries, and align README/custom-language examples with the experimental auxiliary-review-context adoption boundary.

## Steps to Reproduce
Query callers_of with an MFA containing more than Python's integer digit limit; compare README claims with the server_flexible adoption gate.
acceptance_criteria: Oversized or out-of-range arities return a bounded not_found result without broad fallback; normal aliases remain covered; README states experimental auxiliary scope and repository-specific adoption gates; stale built-in Erlang custom-language example is removed.
notes: Final ship-gate regression: public max_results accepts integers too large for SQLite LIMIT and raises OverflowError instead of returning a bounded response.
close_reason: Implementation delivered and verified in the Erlang support commits through dfa0406; external adoption/performance/golden gates remain open and are not being marked as passed.

value: code-review-graph Erlang snapshot is backed up on branch backup/native-erlang-20260829 at commit 546c442. Hybrid decision: Generic Tree-sitter baseline, ELP targeted enrichment, rebar3 xref module evidence, Dialyzer type diagnostics; remain auxiliary review context until server_flexible golden-case precision/Recall@10/impact/latency gates pass. Full hermetic pytest passed 3097 passed, 9 skipped, 2 xpassed; focused Erlang/lifecycle suite passed 314. codex-plan.md remains intentionally untracked; no push was requested or performed. Full Ruff/Mypy are not green due pre-existing unrelated Ruff test violations, missing dependency stubs, and native typing diagnostics; changed-file Ruff passed.
